description: This file defines data structures, constants, and types related to the management and interaction with MCP (Mesh Control Plane) servers, processes, resources, tools, and protocol messaging within the control-plane component of a system. It includes configurations, server status representations, process management, and JSON-RPC message types.

classes.name: MCPServerConfig
classes.description: Represents configuration details for an MCP server, including connection info, transport, runtime, and metadata.

classes.name: MCPProcess
classes.description: Represents a running MCP server process, including its configuration, command, IO streams, and context for management.

classes.name: MCPServerStatus
classes.description: Type alias for server status, with predefined string constants indicating the server's state.

classes.name: MCPServerInfo
classes.description: Contains status information about an MCP server, including its identification, current state, connection details, and metadata.

classes.name: MCPTool
classes.description: Defines an MCP tool, including its name, description, and input/output schemas.

classes.name: MCPResource
classes.description: Represents a resource managed by MCP, with URI, name, description, and MIME type.

classes.name: MCPManifest
classes.description: Encapsulates the capabilities and resources available from an MCP server, including tools, resources, and version.

classes.name: MCPRequest
classes.description: Models a JSON-RPC request to an MCP server, with method, params, and identification.

classes.name: MCPNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC notification message without an ID, for server-to-client or client-to-server notifications.

classes.name: MCPResponse
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response, including result or error information.

classes.name: MCPError
classes.description: Details an error returned in MCP protocol responses, with code, message, and optional data.

classes.name: InitializeParams
classes.description: Parameters sent during MCP initialization handshake, including protocol version, capabilities, and client info.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: Provides information about the client initiating MCP communication.

classes.name: MCPToolsListResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of available MCP tools.

classes.name: MCPResourcesListResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of MCP resources.

classes.name: MCPToolDefinition
classes.description: Detailed description of a tool, including input schema.

classes.name: MCPResourceDefinition
classes.description: Detailed description of a resource, including MIME type and URI.

methods.name: exec.Cmd
methods.description: Represents an external command being prepared or run; used for process execution.
